**The University of Jordan**  
**Curriculum for Master Degree**  
**Accreditation and Quality Assurance**  

---

**0401780 Major Rules of the Great Ten Modes of Reading (1)**  
*(3 Credit Hours)*  
This course aims to introduce students to the famous book Taybat al-Nashr in the Ten Modes of Reading, its author and its commentaries. Taybat al-Nashr will be studied from the beginning to chapter the Pause of Hamzah and Hisham along with practical reading of the first juz' of surat al-Baqarah (Q2).

---

**0401781 Major Rules of the Great Ten Modes of Reading (2)**  
*(3 Credit Hours)*  
This course aims to, Taybat al-Nashr will be studied from chapter the Manifestation and Assimilation to chapter Reciting Modes of Reading Individually and Collectively along with practical reading of the second juz' of surat al-Baqarah (Q2).

---

**0401782 Reciting the Qur'an According to the Great Ten Modes of Reading**  
*(3 Credit Hours)*  
This course aims to, students will read the Qur'an from the third juz' to the end of Chapter al-An'am (Q6) according to Taybat al-Nashr.

---

**0401783 The Impact of the Variations of Modes of Reading on Pause and Start**  
*(3 Credit Hours)*  
This course aims to introduce students to the pause and start, their types, their relationship with the modes of reading and scholars’ approaches in tackling this matter. A practical study of selected examples will be presented.

---

**0401784 Qur'anic Modes of Reading in Oriental and Modern Studies**  
*(3 Credit Hours)*  
This course aims to explore the writings of orientalists and modernists about Qur'anic modes of reading. It critically examines their methodologies. Additionally, this course will deal with some doubts regarding the Qur'anic modes of reading.

---

**0401785 Generations of Reciters**  
*(3 Credit Hours)*  
This course aims to look at the biographies of some great reciters across the centuries and then it will study a selected sample of a number of reciters in each generation.

---

**0401786 Phonetics in Recitations and Qur'anic Readings**  
*(3 Credit Hours)*  
This course aims to analytically the Qur'anic phonetics included in the recitation and Qur'anic reading in comparison with contemporary phonetical studies. It also includes comparative practical aspects in order to reach sounds views about their impact on meaning.

---

**0401788 Qur'anic Orthography and Verses Counting**  
*(3 Credit Hours)*  
This course aims to student an introduction about the science of Qur'anic orthography and its most important principles. Moreover, it deals with the science of verses counting. Also, how these sciences developed will be investigated.
